decisions.reason: As a flagship extension of core vessel-management capabilities into offshore shipping, it builds strongly on the firm's existing operational, crewing and safety knowledge and is therefore likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

Crew and corporate travel management is highly adjacent to the firm's established maritime support services, so the firm can readily absorb customer feedback and run it efficiently with existing administrative and client-service capabilities.

The online vessel information portal is more digitally demanding than the firm's traditional services, but as a flagged growth area it still draws on the firm's vessel data, customer relationships and process knowledge enough to justify continued development.

The mobile vessel performance app is related to the firm's operational expertise and sustainability direction, yet its software-heavy nature makes learning and commercialization harder, so it is the most at risk of being discontinued if uptake disappoints.
